device.text: New laptop NB-0702, manufacturer warranty until March 2027

subject.text: New laptop completely dead after two months

description.text: I've only used this laptop for two months, and suddenly it won't turn on at all.
I tried a coworker's charger of the same type, and it still won't turn on.
Could you open it up and replace the broken part here? I need it fast.

history.text: Yesterday, IT Workshop technician: power and charger normal, motherboard test failed, error code light blinking.
Asset note: the warranty seal on the case screw is still intact. Opening the case voids the warranty; repairs must go through the official vendor.

explanation: The motherboard failed its test, but the laptop is still under warranty with the seal intact, so opening it ourselves would void the warranty. Escalate to the official vendor through a warranty claim, including notes on the tests already done.
hints: The broken part has been found. But who is allowed to repair it?
Read the asset note about the warranty seal before opening the case.
